title: Tewar wohi
body:
tewar wohi shabab wohi wohi baakpan tamaam
abbas ko milay hai ali ke chalan tamaam
<<DIVIDER>>
sher e khuda ka sher chala hai suye furaat
haibat ye hai ke kaampta hai ran ka ran tamaam
tewar wohi…
<<DIVIDER>>
shayad kisi ne tok diya hai dilayr ko
goonja hua hai sher ke naaron se ban tamaam
tewar wohi…
<<DIVIDER>>
roke na ruk sakega yadullah ka pisar
ay fauje shaam dekhle kaate jatan tamaam
tewar wohi…
<<DIVIDER>>
bano ke gulbadan ne hasi mein uda diya
bekaar hogaya bine kaahil ka fan tamaam
tewar wohi…
<<DIVIDER>>
hai karbala pe khatm musibat ki daastan
haaton pe baap ke hua ghuncha dahan tamaam
tewar wohi…
<<DIVIDER>>
zeene faraz se khaak pe pahunche to kis tarha
teeron mein hai gundha hua sheh ka badan tamaam
tewar wohi…
